## What lives here
The maintained frontend: TanStack Start (React 19, SSR), generated from a Lovable template, with Tailwind v4 and shadcn/ui. It is built as a Node server for production.

## Conventions
Calls only relative `/api` URLs. Every colour is a token in `src/styles.css`. Uses bun (`bun.lock`).

## Entry points
`src/routes/__root.tsx`, `vite.config.ts`, the `Dockerfile` and `package.json`.
